literal: praised things having cherished doing is needed; without doing to those who neglected even in seven births there is not.
translation: One must cherish and perform the deeds praised by the wise. Those who neglect and fail to do them will find no benefit in any of their seven births.
modern: அறிஞர்களால் புகழப்பட்ட நற்செயல்களை மறக்காமல் போற்றிச் செய்ய வேண்டும். அவற்றைச் செய்யாமல் கைவிட்டவர்களுக்கு ஏழேழு பிறவியிலும் எந்த நன்மையும் இல்லை.
explanation: The couplet advises us to carefully remember and perform actions that are praised by the wise. The word 'போற்றி' (cherishing) emphasizes doing these deeds with care and without negligence. If one neglects these duties, they will not achieve any good across all seven cycles of birth.
